system: Autonomous Course Platform (Self-Contained Gradescope & Canvas Replacement)
overarching_goal: Build a completely self-contained class platform over the next two months, replacing both Gradescope and Canvas, with complete instructor admin control, student self-service dashboards, automated group Google Docs with live LaTeX rendering, and dual AI/collaboration inference with post-submission reflection loops.

bugs.title: Student Self-Service Account Creation & Identity Management
bugs.description: Enable students to self-register, link their Duke NetID/email, configure secure passwords, and maintain profile details without manual roster import dependency.
bugs.progress: Designed schema and initial authentication models; integration with Duke LDAP directory verification planned.

bugs.title: Comprehensive Student Individualized Dashboard
bugs.description: Multi-component dashboard displaying: (1) overall academic standing and component-level status (worksheets, quizzes, labs, midterm), (2) notification frequency/channel controls, (3) self-service extension requests, and (4) communication hub from Rann and TAs.
bugs.progress: Component breakdown models and status reporting logic ported from student_status_reporter.py. UI mockups created.

bugs.title: Complete Instructor Administrative Console & Granular TA Permission Levels
bugs.description: Full instructor administrative control for Rann with modular Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) supporting Level 1 (Grader), Level 2 (TA), Level 3 (Head TA), and Level 4 (Admin) with extension caps and guardrails.
bugs.progress: Implemented in staff_permissions.json and rbac_permissions_manager.py. Ready for admin dashboard hookup.

bugs.title: Automated Group Autodetection & Autocreation Engine
bugs.description: Automatically detect and form student groups (lab groups, video project groups, peer cohorts) based on section enrollment, lab scheduling, and student preference graphs.
bugs.progress: Requirements specified; clustering algorithm based on section lab schedules in design.

bugs.title: Automated Google Docs Provisioning for Lab Groups
bugs.description: For each detected lab group, automatically provision a dedicated, pre-templated Google Doc for each lab module with group sharing permissions, revision history tracking, and instructor audit access.
bugs.progress: Google Docs API integration architecture designed; OAuth service account requirements documented.

bugs.title: Google Docs Live Math Parsing & Background LaTeX Rendering Daemon
bugs.description: Background poller running every few minutes to scan active student lab Google Docs, identify typed mathematical expressions, convert them to standard LaTeX, and render publication-quality KaTeX/LaTeX graphics inline.
bugs.progress: Syntax regex parser developed; KaTeX serverless renderer pipeline prototyped.

bugs.title: Dual Submission Inference Engine: AI Probability & Collaborator Detection
bugs.description: For every student submission, calculate two probabilistic metrics: (1) Probability the work was generated/assisted by AI, and (2) Probabilities of specific peer students the author collaborated with via semantic vector similarity and shared error graph matching.
bugs.progress: Text tokenization, perplexity scoring, and pairwise n-gram / semantic embedding similarity graph designed.

bugs.title: Real-Time Post-Submission Student Reflection & Automatic Grace Extension Loop
bugs.description: Immediately upon submitting, show the student their computed AI probability and detected collaborators. Ask: 'Approve submission as final or continue working on it?' If student chooses to improve and deadline is imminent, grant an automatic configurable extension (6-12h).
bugs.progress: Workflow state machine specified; extension grant hook connected to rbac_permissions_manager.py.

bugs.title: Core Gradescope Engine Replacement (Grading Interface & Rubric Engine)
bugs.description: Fully replace Gradescope grading capabilities: multi-page PDF rendering, dynamic rubric item scoring, point deductions, inline LaTeX annotations, regrade request workflows, and score rollups.
bugs.progress: Gradescope rubric data structures fully mapped in gradescope_tasks.py; local web canvas interface in progress.

bugs.title: Core Canvas Engine Replacement (Gradebook Calculation & Course Sync)
bugs.description: Replace useful Canvas capabilities: weighted gradebook calculations (drop lowest 2 worksheets/quizzes), syllabus schedule, announcement broadcasts, and attendance audit logging.
bugs.progress: Canvas attendance sync and gradebook CSV exporter operational in canvas_attendance_reporter.py and update_grades.py.

bugs.title: False-Positive Scan Detection on Mobile App PDFs
bugs.description: Submissions generated by dedicated mobile document scanning apps (Gradescope App, Genius Scan, Adobe Scan) were incorrectly classified as raw photos due to lack of vector font streams.
bugs.progress: Updated PDF metadata parser to whitelist recognized mobile scanning engines & contrast filters.

bugs.title: Hourly Duplicate Dispatch on 100% Superb Work Notifications
bugs.description: Scheduled task sent duplicate congratulatory emails to students due to MS Graph Sent Items pagination truncation ($top=10).
bugs.progress: Replaced generic top-level SentItems query with student-specific search filter and persistent JSON tracking lock.

bugs.title: Private Multi-Tier Internal Operations Dashboard & Project Management Portal
bugs.description: Private internal web dashboard allowing users with various permission levels (Admin, Lead TA, TA, Grader, Research Collaborator, Viewer) to monitor real-time background tasks, create and update bug reports, track project metrics, and advance workflows.
bugs.progress: Architecture and permission schema designed; prototype web interface created with live status views and bug reporting hooks.

bugs.title: Mac Server Compute Offloading & Distributed Backend Infrastructure
bugs.description: Transition backend heavy lifting to incoming dedicated Mac Server (vote forecasting Monte Carlo engines, continuous Gradescope synchronizers, KaTeX live rendering daemons, LaTeX compilation pipelines), leaving current workstation as a lightweight front-end client.
bugs.progress: Workload partitioning model drafted; persistent background workers and sync scripts prepared for migration.

bugs.title: Weekly Automated Dean Communication Summary for Isaiah Nwoko
bugs.description: Weekly automated report compiled every Monday morning at 8:00 AM detailing all communications, submissions, ARC recovery schedules, and check-ins with Isaiah Nwoko since the previous report, dispatched to his academic dean and instructor.
bugs.progress: Tracking ledger and Monday 8:00 AM cron daemon registered; initial report compiled for Rann.

bugs.title: Automated Watermarked Multi-Stakeholder Dispatch Pipeline (DRAFT & Confidential)
bugs.description: Conditional batch dispatch pipeline applying 'DRAFT' watermarks and giant red 'CONFIDENTIAL INTERNAL ONLY' prefaces to all architectural reports, routing tailored subject lines to TAs ('outline of ambition for next semester'), Alaina McBride, Paul Bendich & Greg Herschlag (now receiving ALL reports: Elections goals with NLQ measurables, LaTeX guide, and Bug tracker guide), faculty colleagues via Duke LDAP, and a consolidated all-in-one report to Tal Matalon.
bugs.progress: Greg & Paul package updated to include ALL reports and all 3 PDFs (NC Elections Strategic Goals, LaTeX Guide, Student Bug Tracker Guide); staged awaiting Rann's signal.

bugs.title: Omni-Project Natural Language Query (NLQ) Engine & Measurables Suite
bugs.description: Natural language query substrate empowering all authorized users (admins, researchers, TAs, students) to query any project in any way — from election models and precinct shapefiles to courseware rubrics, student submission audits, and bug tickets.
bugs.progress: Integrated into Pillar 6 of Strategic Goals with 5 core measurables (Latency <=1.2s, Semantic Precision >=98.5%, Firewall Compliance 100%, Zero-Shot >=95%, Coverage 100%); nlq_measurables_engine.py created and passing 100%.

bugs.title: Automated 24h In-Class Readiness Reminder (Worksheet or iPad)
bugs.description: Automated notification engine broadcasting a 24-hour advance reminder before every Math 105L lecture (MWF) and lab (T/Th) requiring every student to have a physically printed worksheet or iPad/tablet with stylus ready.
bugs.progress: Active broadcast sent for Wednesday class; background daemon armed for 9:00 AM Sun-Thu schedule.

bugs.title: Quiz Retake 5-Minute Post-Completion Immediate Scorer Daemon
bugs.description: Monitors Gradescope for quiz retake completions. Automatically enforces a 5-minute wait post-completion (sub_dt or time limit expiration), then immediately emails individual scores to students with CC to rb6@duke.edu. Fully guarded against old assignments and dropped students.
bugs.resolution: Implemented in quiz_retake_immediate_scorer.py and task_notify_quiz_retake_scores; armed standing daemon task-14192 (*/2 * * * *). Live tested and verified with 7 students notified.
